Peeled onion and separated onion skins on the work surface

visible_evidence: Knife repeatedly chopping the cut garlic piece finely
Finely minced garlic bits on the cutting board

checks.text: The cut garlic piece is chopped into very fine minced bits

visible_evidence: Knife slicing the peeled onion in half

steps.text: Cut-Cut 1/4 medium carrot into short, thin strips

visible_evidence: Knife slicing a portion of onion on a cutting board

steps.text: Top-Top the plate with the carrots, onion, garlic and 1/4 tsp pepper powder

Closing the microwave door and setting the timer for 1.5 minutes on high

The microwave is set to high power

Using a spoon to stir the meatballs, vegetables, and sauce on the plate
